title: Banner
description: An announcement strip for the top of a page composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Badge, Button, Alert and Skeleton primitives: a badge, a bold title and one line of message, one action and a dismiss that hides the strip, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the action moves beside the message at @sm, the badge, title and message share one line at @md and the message centres in the strip at @lg.
